name: Aphelion Buoy Haven
core_rationale: Outermost lantern-lit comet-buoy town of Continent 03 at [1, 1] built atop a captured blue-ice comet shard where star-navigators chart the Outer Orbit Drift above the Comet-Core Geode.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Warm starlight-heated meltwater pools carved into translucent blue comet-glass plazas

North.lock_message: Sub-zero comet-tail shear sweeps the northern Outer Orbit Drift; Buoy-Keeper Astraea requires the Geode Resonance Prism before unlocking the outer mooring.

resident_npcs.name: Buoy-Keeper Astraea
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Aphelion Buoy Haven! Warm your gloves at our 0.60 meter starlight-brazier desk while the comet-chimes ring overhead.

resident_npcs.name: Geode-Cutter Caelum
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Inside the Comet-Core Geode below us, a crystalline star-seraph guards the Geode Resonance Prism needed to brave the Outer Orbit Drift!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Aphelion Halo Rim at [1, 1] atop Vesper's outermost captured comet-shard.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A cozy lantern-lit haven carved into a glowing blue comet-shard at the edge of the twilight sky.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Brazier desks at 0.58 to 0.60m, comet-glass risers at 0.14m, doorways 2.20m x 1.65m, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Symmetric West portal to hunting-area-comet-tether-span, Dungeon portal to dungeon-comet-core-geode, and North fog_of_lore portal to hunting-area-outer-orbit-drift.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Outer Orbit Drift behind a fog_of_lore boundary portal and Buoy-Keeper lock message.
